# `collab/CollabOpQueue.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/CollabOpQueue.js`

CollabOpQueue.js Op ordering, deduplication, and per-peer sequence gap handling. Each op: { id, peerId, seq, type, payload, ts } Current scope: bounded local ordering for admitted logical peer IDs. Sequence epochs/wrap, retransmission/NACK, cryptographic sender binding, and captured loss/reordering transport traces remain audit gaps.

### `enqueueOp(queue, op)`

Enqueue an incoming op. Returns array of ops ready to apply.

### `flushPeer(queue, peerId)`

Flush all held ops for a peer (called on timeout or peer leave).

### `removePeer(queue, peerId)`

Remove all state for a peer (on disconnect).

### `tickOpQueue(queue)`

Tick — flush any peers with stale gaps.
